summary.text: Sean Hornbuckle is a Democratic member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 25, where he has served since 2015, and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hornbuckle has served as House minority leader since 2023 and works as a financial representative.

paragraphs.text: Sean Hornbuckle was born in Huntington, West Virginia, and graduated from Huntington High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in sports management and marketing and an M.B.A., both from Marshall University.
His career experience includes working as a financial representative at MassMutual.

Hornbuckle's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Economic Development, Education (minority chair), Pensions and Insurance (minority chair) and Workforce Development (minority vice-chair).
He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026.
